claims: The 2026 NFL Draft will take place from April 23–25, 2026.
The 2026 NFL Draft will take place in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
Events of the 2026 NFL Draft will be centered around Point State Park and Acrisure Stadium.
Round 1 of the 2026 NFL Draft is scheduled for Thursday, April 23 at 8 p.m. ET.
Rounds 2-3 of the 2026 NFL Draft are scheduled for Friday, April 24 at 7 p.m. ET.
Rounds 4-7 of the 2026 NFL Draft are scheduled for Saturday, April 25 at noon ET.
The 2026 NFL Draft will be the 91st edition of the NFL Draft.
The 2026 NFL Draft will be the first NFL Draft held in Pittsburgh since 1948.
